name: MinMaxMedical
description: MinMaxMedical (MMM) is a medical technology company based in Saint-Martin-d'Hères and Apprieu (Grenoble), France. Founded in 2008 by Stéphane Lavallée, MMM conducts R&D in computer-assisted surgery, real-time reconfigurable surgical robotics, and navigation sensors. In coordination with the Haventure startup studio, MMM incubated and co-developed foundational technologies for sister Grenoble ventures founded by Lavallée—including Orthotaxy (acquired in 2018 by DePuy Synthes / [Johnson & Johnson MedTech](/company/johnson_johnson_medtech) to become the [VELYS](/robot/j&j_velys) knee platform, followed by DePuy Synthes's 2020 acquisition of MMM's Gemtrack miniature radiofrequency tracking technology) and [eCential Robotics](/company/ecential_robotics) (founded in 2009 as Surgivisio).
